title: 开挖与沟槽安全十五问

points.K6: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险
points.S2: 校园开挖区绕行与警示

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽站在围挡外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet stands outside a construction fence and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天十五道题，讲讲开挖和沟槽安全。
overlay: 开挖与沟槽安全十五问

shots.scene: 一行图标：挖掘机、沟槽、支撑板、梯子
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: an excavator, a trench, shoring panels and a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 防塌方、测气体、设梯子、勤检查。

shots.scene: 实验楼旁，一条正在开挖的管沟，围挡和警示灯
shots.prompt_en: Next to a laboratory building, a trench is being dug for new pipes, with fences and warning lights.
shots.narration: 实验楼旁要开挖管沟，铺设新管线。

shots.scene: 阿杰趴在围挡边往沟里看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans over the fence to peer into the trench.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇，凑到沟边往下看。

shots.scene: 老李把阿杰请离坑边
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer waves the young male student back from the trench edge.
shots.narration: 老李请他退后：沟边最容易塌。

shots.scene: 深沟剖面图，沟底飘着淡淡的气体
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a deep trench with faint gas drifting at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：沟挖深了要注意什么？

shots.scene: 检测仪探头伸进沟底
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector probe is lowered into the trench bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 检查有没有危险气体，再让人下去。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 深度界限按国内规范，不照搬原题。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上氧气图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector display showing an oxygen icon with a green band. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：沟里的氧含量要测吗？

shots.scene: 附近管道漏气、低洼积聚的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of gas leaking from a nearby pipe and pooling in a low trench. No people.
shots.narration: 要测，低洼处可能缺氧或积聚气体。

shots.scene: 数值卡片被国标书替代
shots.prompt_en: Number cards are replaced by a closed standard book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 合格范围以现行标准为准。

shots.scene: 沟槽紧挨着建筑基础和挡土墙
shots.prompt_en: A trench dug right next to a building foundation and a retaining wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：在基础底下开挖可以吗？

shots.scene: 挡墙倾斜开裂的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a retaining wall tilting and cracking, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不设支撑，墙和楼都可能失稳。

shots.scene: 支撑系统装好，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A support system installed against the foundation, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 正确：先有支撑，才能挖。

shots.scene: 一条浅沟，旁边打问号
shots.prompt_en: A shallow trench with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：浅沟就不用防塌方？

shots.scene: 浅沟边壁也塌下一块
shots.prompt_en: A chunk of soil falls from the wall of a shallow trench. No people.
shots.narration: 原题有深度界限，但浅沟也会塌。

shots.scene: 专业人员查看土质，旁边国标书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and a technician examine the soil wall beside a closed standard book.
shots.narration: 要不要支护，按规范和专业判断。

shots.scene: 四个图标：管涌、塌方、鼓胀、冲蚀
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: water boiling up, a trench wall collapsing, a bulging wall and eroded edges. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：最常见的土体失稳是什么？

shots.scene: 塌方图标亮红
shots.prompt_en: The collapsing wall icon glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 是塌方，几秒钟就能埋住人。

shots.section_title: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险
shots.scene: 坑边堆土、停着车辆、雨云、振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: A trench edge with a soil pile, a parked truck, a rain cloud and vibration waves. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：什么会加大塌方风险？
overlay: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险

shots.section_title: 荷载、天气、振动加大风险
shots.scene: 堆土和车辆远离坑边，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The soil pile and the truck are moved back from the edge, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 坑边堆物、车辆、雨水、振动都算。

shots.scene: 老李每天早上沿沟检查，拿着检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks along the trench in the morning with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第七题：要不要每天有人检查？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 要，由懂行的专人每天查。

shots.scene: 沟里挤满人的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a trench crowded with workers, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：怎样随时降低沟槽风险？

shots.scene: 沟里只留必要的一两人
shots.prompt_en: Only one or two workers in the trench, others waiting outside. No people.
shots.narration: 限制沟里的人数，不需要的别下去。

shots.scene: 滑倒、坠落、埋压、绊倒四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: slipping, falling, being buried and tripping. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：沟槽里最致命的是什么？

shots.scene: 埋压图标亮红
shots.prompt_en: The being-buried icon glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 被土埋压卷入，最容易致命。

shots.scene: 检测仪在沟边待命
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector placed ready at the trench edge. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：开挖也要测气体吗？

shots.scene: 附近有化学品库、污水管的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nearby chemical store and a sewer pipe beside the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 正确，靠近污水管、化学品库时尤其要测。

shots.scene: 长沟里每隔一段设一架梯子
shots.prompt_en: Ladders placed at intervals along a long trench. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：深长的沟怎么设梯子？

shots.scene: 人形图标就近从梯子撤出
shots.prompt_en: A person icon climbs out by the nearest ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 按规范间隔设，出事能就近撤。

shots.scene: 梯子顶端伸出沟口一截
shots.prompt_en: A ladder extends well above the top edge of the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：梯子要伸出多少？

shots.scene: 手扶梯子顶端跨出沟口
shots.prompt_en: A hand grips the top of the ladder while stepping out of the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 伸出地面一截，上下才有扶手。

shots.scene: 日历和雨云图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon and a rain cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：多久检查一次？

shots.scene: 两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both icons get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 每天查，下雨、震动等变化后再查。

shots.scene: 老李看土壁，再用手捏土样
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer looks at the soil wall, then squeezes a soil sample in his hand.
shots.narration: 第十四题：土质怎么判断？

shots.scene: 眼睛图标和手图标并列
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon and a hand icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 正确：至少一次目测，一次手工测试。

shots.scene: 土块压下、呼吸受阻、没有救援计划三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: heavy soil pressing down, blocked breathing and a blank rescue plan with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五题：埋压为什么致命？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three check marks.
shots.narration: 重压、窒息、没有救援预案，都是原因。

shots.scene: 老李展示空白救援预案和工具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shows a blank rescue plan and rescue tools at the site.
shots.narration: 开工前就要备好救援预案。

shots.scene: 地下剖面：燃气管、电缆、实验楼气体管道
shots.prompt_en: An underground cross-section showing a gas pipe, power cables and a laboratory gas line. No people.
shots.narration: 动土之前，先查清地下管线。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李对照图纸，在地面画出管线位置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer compare a blank site drawing and mark pipe routes on the ground.
shots.narration: 对照图纸，现场标出位置。

shots.scene: 管线附近改用人工小心开挖
shots.prompt_en: Near the marked pipes, workers dig carefully by hand instead of using the excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 靠近管线，改用人工小心挖。

shots.scene: 动土作业票和印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank excavation permit form and a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 动土作业，先办审批。

shots.section_title: 校园开挖区绕行与警示
shots.scene: 围挡、警示灯在夜里闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Construction fences and flashing warning lights around a trench at night. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖区围挡、警示灯，日夜都要有。
overlay: 校园开挖区绕行与警示

shots.section_title: 校园开挖区绕行与警示
shots.scene: 阿杰和同学沿绕行指示走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and classmates follow a detour sign around the trench.
shots.narration: 学生按指示绕行，不翻越围挡。

shots.scene: 雨后沟里积水，沟壁变软
shots.prompt_en: After rain, water pools in the trench and the walls look soft. No people.
shots.narration: 下雨后，沟壁更容易塌。

shots.scene: 水泵抽水，老李复查后才许下沟
shots.prompt_en: A pump drains the trench while the facility engineer rechecks the walls before allowing entry.
shots.narration: 先排水、再复查，确认安全再下。

shots.scene: 工人弯腰挥锹，腰背红点
shots.prompt_en: A worker bends deeply while shoveling; the lower back glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间弯腰挖土，腰背容易劳损。

shots.scene: 换用长柄锹，膝盖微屈、背挺直
shots.prompt_en: A worker uses a long-handled shovel with slightly bent knees and a straight back. No people.
shots.narration: 用长柄工具，屈膝挺背，别扭腰甩土。

shots.scene: 两人轮换，一人休息喝水
shots.prompt_en: Two workers take turns digging while one rests and drinks water. No people.
shots.narration: 轮换作业，定时休息。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验楼门口张贴空白通知
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator posts a blank notice at the laboratory building entrance.
shots.narration: 实验楼旁开挖，先通知各实验室。

shots.scene: 停水、停电、停气三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a water tap, a plug and a gas valve, each with a pause symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 可能停水停电停气，提前安排实验。

shots.scene: 精密天平旁出现振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: Vibration waves appear next to a precision balance on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 振动会影响精密仪器，提前固定或暂停。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在沟槽剖面图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a trench cross-section diagram.
shots.narration: 沟深要测气，支护按规范。

shots.scene: 堆土远离坑边、沟内人数少
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a soil pile away from the edge and few workers in the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 坑边少堆载，沟里少站人。

shots.scene: 梯子、日历、雨云图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ladder, a calendar and a rain cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子伸出地面，每天和雨后都要查。

shots.scene: 管线图纸和实验楼通知图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pipe drawing and a notice on a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 动土先查管线，提前通知实验室。

shots.scene: 欣欣在围挡外挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside the construction fence.
shots.narration: 沟边多一步，安全多一分！
